headword: {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート
reading: てっきんこんくりーと

definitions.explanation: Concrete strengthened with steel bars or mesh embedded within it. The standard construction material for buildings and infrastructure in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート{造|づく}りだ。
examples.english: This building is made of reinforced concrete.

examples.japanese: {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐震性|たいしんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Reinforced concrete buildings have high earthquake resistance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧{三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a thirty-year-old reinforced concrete apartment building.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated as RC ({鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧) in real estate listings and construction documents. Appears frequently in apartment and housing descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート{造|づく}り (reinforced concrete construction)
- {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (reinforced concrete building)
- RC{造|ぞう} (RC construction — abbreviated form)
